description: This file defines classes and logic for indexing TextField content in OrchardCore, including the TextFieldIndex class and the TextFieldIndexProvider class which maps content items to index entries.

classes.name: TextFieldIndex
classes.description: Represents an index entry for a TextField, including text content and size constraints.

classes.name: TextFieldIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for TextField content, mapping content items to index entries based on content type and fields.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to TextFieldIndex entries, including filtering and field extraction.
